title: ITシステム基礎
subtitle: Information Technology Basic
educationalGoal: Information technology (IT) affects life and business, but in order to use it efficiently, it is necessary to have an appropriate understanding of its functions. In this course, students learn system development and system management based on the fundamental concepts of information systems and communication networks.
advice: The following topics, which form a portion of the basic knowledge shared by all IT engineers, will be covered during this course: 1. Table calculation Absolute and relative reference, arithmetic functions, and the “if” function. 2. Network and internet IP addresses, OSI reference models, and network and Internet mechanisms. 3. System development System development, system assessment, and system management 4. Corporate activities
books: Textbook: 「キタミ式イラストIT塾 ITパスポート 令和04年」 (技術評論社)
requiredKnowledge: Familiarity with PC operations and table calculations will help facilitate learning. Students are required to bring own computers.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand absolute and relative reference in table calculation.
Be able to use the “if” function in table calculation.
Be able to understand the mechanisms of an IP address.
Be able to understand the mechanisms of a network.
Be able to grasp system development and system assessment.
Be able to understand corporate activities and their social responsibilities.
